m2-guard-main.imperative: In main()'s tail, change `if wire_repo_mcp_config:` so the entire apply_repo_mcp_config_wiring call is skipped unless `mcp_config_path is not None or is_self_install(args)` -- exact condition fixed by the handoff. Do not touch default_mcp_config_path() itself. Verify every existing RepoMcpConfigWiringTests case still passes unmodified.

m3-bug-proof-test.title: Add the byte-identical CLI-shaped regression test and update the docstring
m3-bug-proof-test.imperative: Add one new test to RepoMcpConfigWiringTests proving the confirmed bug is fixed: call installer.main() with CLI-shaped args (--agent claude --scope user --dest <tmp-outside-the-repo> --skills workbench), wire_repo_mcp_config=True, no mcp_config_path override (resolves via the real default_mcp_config_path()). Never touch this checkout's own real tracked .mcp.json: default_mcp_config_path()'s repo_root parameter is bound to REPO_ROOT at module-definition time (a Python default-argument is evaluated once, at def, not re-read from the module global afterward), so a plain mock.patch.object(installer, 'REPO_ROOT', ...) after load_installer() is inert for this function -- confirmed by a standalone repro. Redirect default_mcp_config_path()'s bound default safely and verifiably by patching installer.default_mcp_config_path.__defaults__ to a throwaway git-initialized fixture directory's path (restoring the original tuple in a finally), and additionally patch installer.REPO_ROOT to the same fixture dir for symbolic consistency with the handoff wording. Snapshot the fixture .mcp.json bytes before the call, assert byte-identical after. Update ONLY the docstring of test_default_mcp_config_path_points_at_this_checkouts_own_mcp_json to note the real CLI entry point now only calls wiring with this path when is_self_install holds -- its assertion body stays unchanged.
